evidence.quote: JEREMIE Co-Investment Fund, s.r.o. v likvidácii - IČO: 47254734
Registrovaný správca neprijal žiadne nové investičné rozhodnutia od 1. novembra 2016.

Currently, we are looking for investment opportunities in Late Seed & Series A rounds in revenue-generating firms primarily emerging from the Czech and Slovak region, with a focus on Industrial Tech and other B2B businesses.
Gradually, Limerock has diversified also into venture capital investing when we started to manage JEREMIE Co-Investment Fund based on the mandate from European Investment Fund.
The fund has completed its divestment process and is currently undergoing liquidation.

The fund's investment period ran from 2014 to 2016 and focused on supporting small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) through equity investments made alongside private investors on a pari passu basis.
Fond je uzavretým alternatívnym investičným fondom, ktorý drží historické portfólio investičných aktív nadobudnutých v súlade s jeho investičnou stratégiou.

analyst_notes: Inactive (E7): Limerock's own SFDR disclosure says the registered manager has taken no new investment decisions since 1 Nov 2016 and that the fund (JEREMIE Co-Investment Fund, s.r.o., IČO 47254734) does not raise capital or seek new deals; SIH says the fund has finished divesting and is in liquidation (ORSR name 'v likvidácii' since 2026-06-06). The 2025-07-25 NBS registration date of Limerock Investment Holding, s.r.o. reflects its merger with Limerock Fund Manager, s. r. o. (IČO 47254718, legal predecessor per ORSR from 2025-07-25), not a new fund. Limerock's homepage still says it looks for Late Seed & Series A deals (CZ/SK, industrial tech/B2B), but no vehicle or deal after 2016 was found. ORSR: JEREMIE Co-Investment Fund partners are National Development Fund I., s. r. o. (SIH, IČO 44690487) and Limerock Investment Holding; Limerock Investment Holding is owned by Limerock Advisory, s.r.o. (IČO 46092897; owners Roman Čmelík, Michal Jablonka) and Aika Group Oy (Finland). Limerock's SFDR page prints the manager's IČO as '44 777 028' (typo; ORSR and RÚZ: 47777028). Portfolio logos on limerock.sk (alt text, not quotable): Amena Displays, Aykiro, Gevorkyan (listed), Jaspravim, Maxsport, Runecast, Zlty melon - not linked as investments for lack of a quotable source. Related: Michal Jablonka and Roman Čmelík are also co-founders of Zero Gravity Capital (see zero-one-hundred). Limerock Advisory also does M&A advisory (E1 activity, not the investor record). Ticket and capital not disclosed. eif-portfolio not added: the EIF JEREMIE 2014 Slovakia page now returns 404 and Limerock is not on the current EIF fund-partner list.
